placements.title: The kept value is the perspective, not the substrate
placements.theme: Owned intelligence's durable value lives in the perspective built on top of the substrate, not in the substrate itself — the substrate is a commodity, the perspective is the asset an owner keeps.
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 both carry the same directional claim about where value in owned-vs-rented intelligence actually resides: not in the interchangeable base layer but in the perspective built on it. This is a subject future envelopes about ownership/positioning will keep feeding, not a one-time fact, so it clears the narrative grain test. No existing leaf or strata name exists in this fresh space to reuse, so it is minted standalone with no forced parent.
